messages:
jules: quick idea from the onboarding retro: can we add a 'golden replay' step that replays a small slice of sanitized production traces through new models + tiny perturbations to uncover compatibility and quality cliffs?

nina: interesting. do you mean we store real user requests? privacy concerns are obvious.

jules: yes — sanitized and hashed. store only prompt buckets and token counts, no PII. plus we run perturbations (paraphrase, longer context, kv-cache-miss injection) to probe regression surfaces.

omar: sounds useful for catching kv-cache regressions. how is this different from deepbench?

jules: deepbench is exhaustive/full-device. golden replay is lightweight, reproducible, and targeted at regressions we actually see in prod. target cost ~5 of deepbench and fast enough to run in preflight.

kelly: gating question: will golden replay block onboarding or just create tickets?

prod: product preference: flag first, block only if we see >X% of golden traces change intent or hallucinate. we need clear thresholds.

nina: implementation: where do these traces live? model.yaml? central trace-store? We need access control and retention policies.

jules: propose central trace-store service (internal), trace-ids referenced by model metadata; onboarding job pulls trace IDs, applies sandboxed perturbations. retention 30d by default, longer for specific cohorts. access limited to bench service account.

omar: technical detail: we must simulate KV miss/hits. How do we inject kv-miss?

jules: two approaches: 1) run with empty KV cache (cold-start) and 2) algorithmically strip prefixes to invalidate cache entries. Both count as separate perturbation passes.

bench-bot: golden-replay/job-112 queued: 30 traces x 4 perturbations (base, paraphrase, kv-cold, long-context) estimated run time 18 mins.

kelly: metrics to collect: per-trace BLEU/ROUGE-like similarity? better: embedding-distance + safety/hallucination classifier score + latency deltas. That avoids fragile token-level diffs.

jules: +1. embedding delta + classifier pass/fail plus p95 latency shift per-trace. add per-trace tags for seq_len, model-quantization, and runtime-profile.

nina: gating rules suggestion: soft alert if mean embedding drift > 0.15 or hallucination classifier precision falls by >5%; hard fail if >20% of traces cross hallucination thresh OR if p95 latency increases >2x absolute and p99 >1.5s. Also require >=25 traces / cohort to be considered valid.

omar: ops note: running perturbations increases IO (paraphrase calls). Can we rely on cheap synthetic paraphrases from local paraphrase model rather than calling external prod APIs?

jules: yes, use an internal lightweight paraphrase model in bench infra. fallback to deterministic synonym substitution for ultra-fast runs.

bench-bot: golden-replay/job-112 finished: mean embed-delta 0.07, halluc-pass 98%, p95 delta +30ms, issues: 2 traces flagged (long-context paraphrase) recommended deepbench follow-up.

kelly: fine. action items: nina 1 draft trace-store ACL + retention RFC; omar 1 add perturbation hooks to intake (kv-cold, strip-prefix); bench infra 1 implement golden-replay profile and metrics export; prod 1 define final gating numbers for launch. I can write the onboarding-playbook blurb for golden-replay.

jules: thanks all. will put a small demo and callouts in next week's RFC follow-up. :party_parrot:
